_comment: Template: map the IDs of one CIM model (model 1) onto another model of the same grid (model 2).
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar id-map --config this-file.json
_note_model1Files: The model whose IDs are mapped; its IDs fill Model1_ID. All files are read as one model. RDF/XML (.xml, .rdf) or ZIPs of them.
_note_model2Files: The model the IDs are mapped to; its IDs fill Model2_ID.
_note_commonFiles: Loaded into both sides and not mapped: the boundary set (boundary nodes anchor the tie lines) and the file with the BaseVoltages (EQ boundary for CGMES 2.4.15, common data for CGMES 3.0). Use [] for none.
_note_output: The workbook: Matched (Model1_ID, Element_type, Model2_ID, Model2_2nd_name, Confidence, Model1_name, Model2_type, Method, Note), Unmatched, Summary. A .xls name gives the old format.
_note_nameAliases: Optional: add "nameAliases": "station-names.csv" when substations are named differently in the two models. One substation per line, its names separated by ; or , e.g. KNOCKAN1;Knockanure.
_note_queryFolder: Optional: add "queryFolder": "my-queries" with edited copies of the SPARQL queries (CimPal-Core/src/main/resources/idmapping/queries); missing files are taken from the bundled set.
_note_useNames: Seed the matching with substations whose names are unique and equal on both sides.
_note_matchSameIds: Match objects with the same ID and class first.
_note_collapseJunctions: Treat a substation that holds only line ends, switches and at most one busbar section, with fewer breakers than line ends (a PowerFactory Term_ point, a cable sealing end, a tee), as part of the line.
_note_groupStations: Treat substations joined by a transformer or switch as one station, for a model that keeps each voltage level of a station as a substation of its own (FINGLAS, FINGLAS1, FINGLAS2).
_note_include: Which objects besides substations, lines and equipment are mapped and reported: terminals, connectivity nodes, dependents (tap changers, limits, controls, units), others (limit types, regions, load groups).
_note_parameterTolerance: Relative tolerance for line r, x, bch and length (0.05 = 5 %). Differences beyond it are noted, not a reason to reject a line the topology identifies.
_note_voltageTolerance: Tolerance in kV for nominal voltages.
_note_secondName: What fills Model2_2nd_name: name, shortName or description.
_note_xmlBase: Base URI for parsing RDF/XML. CGMES 2.4.15 and 3.0 files can both use the default.
_note_format: Summary on stdout: text or json (stdout then holds only the JSON).
